meta.name: vibe-research
meta.description: Deep research and market validation for app ideas. Use when starting a new project, validating an idea, or when the user says "research my idea", "validate my app", or "help me start a new project".

copy.tagline: 验证应用创意并生成市场调研报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有应用想法但不确定是否值得做
copy.tagline_en: Validate app ideas and generate market research reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an app idea but are unsure if it's worth pursuing

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成一系列问题，帮你验证应用创意，并生成一份包含市场分析、技术建议、成本估算等内容的调研报告，保存到项目文件夹。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目、验证一个想法，或说出“research my idea”、“validate my app”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我调研一下我的应用创意。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问，了解你的想法。
Claude 会引导你完成调研流程。

say.text: 我想开始一个新项目，帮我做市场验证。
say.note: Claude 会询问技术背景并逐步提问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a structured question process to validate your app idea, then generates a research report with market analysis, technical recommendations, cost estimates, etc., saved to the project directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new project, validating an idea, or saying "research my idea", "validate my app", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions to understand your idea.
Claude will guide you through the research process.

say_en.text: I want to start a new project, help me validate it.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about your technical background and proceed step by step.
